welcome:
Welcome to the Jenkins CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated Jenkins CI/CD server.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, check your identity and permissions on the Jenkins server.
List all jobs to find the failing pipeline.
The payment-service-pipeline looks suspicious. Get its configuration to understand the stages.
Check the console output of the last build to find the error.
The SonarQube stage failed. Check the build queue to see if a retry is already pending.
Nothing queued. Trigger a new build with the SKIP_SONAR parameter to unblock the release.
Verify the build was queued and check its console output.
Build succeeded. Check the overall node health to make sure agents are stable.
List all jobs currently configured on the server.
The legacy-batch-job is no longer needed. Disable it first (safe before deleting).
Now delete the disabled job entirely.
Create a new pipeline job for the fraud-detection service from an XML config.
List credentials to verify the database secret the new job needs.
Check which plugins are installed — the new job needs the Pipeline Utility Steps plugin.
A plugin install requires a restart. Trigger a safe restart (waits for running builds to finish).

commands.help:
Available commands:
  jenkins-cli who-am-i                — Show current user and permissions
  jenkins-cli list-jobs               — List all jobs on the server
  jenkins-cli get-job <name>          — Get job configuration (XML)
  jenkins-cli create-job <name>       — Create a job from XML on stdin
  jenkins-cli delete-job <name>       — Delete a job
  jenkins-cli disable-job <name>      — Disable a job
  jenkins-cli enable-job <name>       — Enable a disabled job
  jenkins-cli build <name>            — Trigger a build (-p KEY=VAL for params)
  jenkins-cli console <name> <build>  — View console output of a build
  jenkins-cli list-plugins            — List installed plugins
  jenkins-cli install-plugin <name>   — Install a plugin
  jenkins-cli list-credentials <store>— List credentials in a store
  jenkins-cli safe-restart            — Restart after running builds finish
  jenkins-cli safe-shutdown           — Shutdown after running builds finish
  jenkins-cli version                 — Show Jenkins version
  jenkins-cli groovy <script>         — Execute a Groovy script on the server
  curl ...api/json                    — Query Jenkins REST API endpoints
  declarative-linter                  — Validate a Jenkinsfile

  scenario                            — Start a guided lab
  clear                               — Clear the terminal
  help                                — Show this help

commands.jenkins-cli get-job reconciliation-batch:
<?xml version='1.1' encoding='UTF-8'?>
<project>
  <description>Nightly reconciliation batch — CBS vs payment gateway</description>
  <keepDependencies>false</keepDependencies>
  <triggers>
    <hudson.triggers.TimerTrigger>
      <spec>H 2 * * *</spec>
    </hudson.triggers.TimerTrigger>
  </triggers>
  <builders>
    <hudson.tasks.Shell>
      <command>python3 /opt/scripts/reconcile.py --date=$(date -d yesterday +%Y-%m-%d)</command>
    </hudson.tasks.Shell>
  </builders>
</project>
